'''''Ornithoglossum''''' is a genus of plants native to southern [[Africa]], some of which are widely cultivated as ornamentals. Nine species are currently recognized, as of April 2014:<ref name="leighmacphee">[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=282875 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families, ''Ornithoglossum'' ]</ref><ref>Salisbury, Richard Anthony. 1806.  Paradisus Londonensis : or Coloured Figures of Plants Cultivated in the Vicinity of the Metropolis, t. 54. ''Ornithoglossum''</ref>

*''[[Ornithoglossum calcicola]]'' <small>K.Krause & Dinter</small> - [[Namibia]]
*''[[Ornithoglossum dinteri]]'' <small>K.Krause</small> - [[Namibia]], [[South Africa]]
*''[[Ornithoglossum gracile]]'' <small>B.Nord.</small> - [[Cape Province]]
*''[[Ornithoglossum parviflorum]]'' <small>B.Nord.</small> - [[Namibia]], [[Cape Province]]
*''[[Ornithoglossum pulchrum]]'' <small>Snijman, B.Nord. & Mannh.</small> - [[Namibia]]
*''[[Ornithoglossum undulatum]]'' <small>Sweet</small> - [[Namibia]], [[Cape Province]]
*''[[Ornithoglossum viride]]'' <small>(L.f.) Dryand. ex W.T.Aiton</small> - [[Cape Province]]
*''[[Ornithoglossum vulgare]]'' <small>B.Nord.</small> - [[Tanzania]], [[Malawi]], [[Mozambique]], [[Zambia]], [[Zimbabwe]], [[Botswana]], [[Namibia]], [[South Africa]] 
*''[[Ornithoglossum zeyheri]]'' <small>(Baker) B.Nord.</small> - [[Cape Province]]
